titulo.estudio: かえって と むしろ
titulo.alumno: Describing an opposite result with «かえって»

intro: Look at the pattern in short examples and check what information it gives in context.

piezas.titulo: «かえって» indicates the result was the opposite of what was expected; «むしろ» chooses one option as more suitable.
texto: They're not interchangeable in every context. «かえって» signals surprise at the effect; «むしろ» compares two possibilities or corrects a description.
はやく ねた のに、 かえって つかれて しまいました。 (Although I went to bed early, I ended up more tired.)
くるま より、 むしろ でんしゃ の ほう が べんり です。 (Rather than the car, the train is more convenient.)
